_doc_emerald: Emerald's overlay of data/hoenn_weather.json (emerald_world 2026-10-12): deep-merged over it by version.load_json (b2tools/patches/fixed_weather.py data()) in HOENN_VERSION=emerald builds. Emerald's weather triggers stand where Sapphire's do (Route 111, 113, Jagged Pass, Mt. Pyre: checked); the parts recomputed on Emerald's maps with the weather agent's own flood fill and cover (work/agents/weather/regions.py; work/agents/emerald_world/tools/weather_parts.py) differ only on Route 111: the desert's east strip ends at row 107, north of Emerald's Trainer Hill (Sapphire's ran on to row 127 through the strip Trainer Hill now stands on), so Trainer Hill and its plaza have Route 111's clear weather and music. Route 113's and Jagged Pass's hand-made rects already hold Emerald's few extra tiles. The Safari Zone expansion's two parts (postgame_fix 2026-10-19) have no weather of their own: they give each new area pokeemerald's own wild table ('wild', patches/fixed_weather.py).

SafariZone_Northeast_Emerald._emerald: Emerald's Safari Zone expansion, north-east area (pokeemerald SafariZone_Northeast; postgame_fix 2026-10-19): the map shares zone 38 with Sapphire's SafariZone_Northeast (Emerald's SafariZone_North, data/emerald/hoenn_zones.json), whose header plays one wild table; this part over the whole map plays pokeemerald's own gSafariZone_Northeast (Aipom, Teddiursa, Sunkern, Ledyba, Hoothoot, Pineco, Houndour, Miltank; Rock Smash Shuckle: patches/hm_free.py), file 138 (data/emerald/hoenn_encounters.json). Same weather and music as zone 38.

SafariZone_Southeast_Emerald._emerald: Emerald's Safari Zone expansion, south-east area (pokeemerald SafariZone_Southeast; postgame_fix 2026-10-19): the map shares zone 40 with Sapphire's SafariZone_Southeast (Emerald's SafariZone_South); this part plays pokeemerald's own gSafariZone_Southeast (Sunkern, Mareep, Aipom, Spinarak, Hoothoot, Snubbull, Stantler, Gligar; surfing Wooper, Marill, Quagsire; rods Magikarp, Goldeen, Remoraid, Octillery), file 139. Same weather and music as zone 40.
